seg.seg_rev_note: Two segments: Freight Group and Transit Group. Segment sales = sales to external customers as published. ngaap.guidance: Affirmed 2014 guidance for EPS of about $3.45, with revenues expected to be up about 15 percent; includes Fandstan Electric Group acquisition, now expected to close in Q2.
